heading: Today
text: Intervals of clouds and sun, with a few passing, local showers or a thunderstorm.  Highs in the 70s to low 80s.  Southwest winds near 10 mph, becoming north in the afternoon.

heading: Tonight
text: Clearing, cooler, and less humid.  Areas of dense valley fog. Lows in the 40s north, near 40 in the cool spots, and upper 40s and 50s in the Champlain Valley and south.  Winds north near 10 mph, diminishing to light after midnight.

heading: Saturday
text: Areas of dense valley fog burning off.  Partly to mostly sunny.  Highs in the 70s, from near 70 in the far north, close to 80 in the warmest southern valleys.  Winds light, mainly west less than 10 mph.
